meaning:
1) to be weak, sick, frail
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to be incurable
1a2) to be sick
1a3) desperate, incurable, desperately wicked, woeful, very sick (pass participle) (metaph.)
1b) (Niphal) to be sick

elsewhere.note: Nathan departed to his house. Yahweh struck the child that Uriah’s wife bore to David, and it was very sick.
Notwithstanding my right I am considered a liar. My wound is incurable, though I am without disobedience.’
In the day of your planting, you hedge it in. In the morning, you make your seed blossom, but the harvest flees away in the day of grief and of desperate…
Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, which refuses to be healed? Will you indeed be to me as a deceitful brook, like waters that fail?
For her wounds are incurable; for it has come even to Judah. It reaches to the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.
